Then, can you also calculate the electric field strength at a distance of 1 meter and 2 meters from the same point charge? Lastly, can you calculate the electric field strength at a distance of 1 meter from the same point charge but this time located in air?"

medium.description: The medium in which the charge and the point of calculation is located. Default is 'vacuum'.
